json.title: Card Folder

json.name: center-morph-modal

json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: combobox

json.name: command-palette

json.name: cylinder-carousel
json.title: Cylinder Carousel

json.name: dynamic-island
json.title: Dynamic Island

json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: expandable-action-bar
json.title: Expandable Action Bar

json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: expandable-control
json.title: Expandable Control
json.description: Click-to-expand button and chip controls that reveal a label or trailing action through spring layout continuity.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: expandable-tabs

json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: infinite-masonry

json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: knockout-bracket
json.title: Fixtures Knockout Bracket
json.description: Pages one round at a time. The leftmost round stacks at a fixed rhythm, each later round centers between its two feeder matches, and cards, elbow connectors, headers and stage height animate into every new layout. A third place play-off sits below the tree under its own rule. Round names, team artwork, dates and result chips all come from the data you pass.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: loader
json.title: Loader
json.description: Loading indicator with seventeen variants: spinner, dots, bars, dot-matrix, dither, morph, comet, scramble, metaballs, newton, helix, percent, and five terminal-style ascii spinners. Scales from one size prop, uses currentColor, and reduced-motion swaps every transform for a calm opacity pulse.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: marquee
json.title: Marquee
json.description: Infinite horizontal or vertical scroll with pause-on-hover.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: message

json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: message-bubble
json.title: Message Bubble
json.description: A focused conversational surface with visual tones, independent alignment, grouped messages, expandable content, and interactive link or button support.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: message-scroller

json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: morphing-modal

json.name: multi-select

json.name: notification-stack

json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: otp-input
json.title: OTP Input

json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: overflow-actions

json.name: popover

json.description: Composable Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent; the panel oozes out of the trigger through an SVG goo filter with a liquid neck, crisp content fading in on top. Click or hover, controlled or uncontrolled.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: prediction-market

json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: preview-rail

json.description: Codex app-inspired navigation rail with compact ticks that form a hover pyramid and reveal a floating destination preview.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: price-target-fan
json.title: Price Target Fan
json.description: Composable price target chart with Header, Plot, SVG, Axes, History, Targets, Now, Cursor, and Tooltip parts. Supply dated price history and targets; scrub with a pointer or keyboard and customize the active readout.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: project-folder
json.title: Project Folder
json.description: An interactive project folder that opens its file fan on hover or focus, expands into a focus-managed overlay, then retraces the complete path when closed.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: prompt-input
json.title: Prompt Input
json.description: An auto-growing agent composer with prompt actions, model selection, keyboard submission, and animated send and stop states.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: pull-to-refresh
json.title: Pull to Refresh
json.description: Native-feeling pull-to-refresh container with drag resistance, threshold feedback and async refresh handling.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: radio
json.title: Radio Group
json.description: Single-select choice control with a gliding layoutId indicator dot and spring press feedback.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: range-slider
json.title: Range Slider Range Slider
json.description: Tick dots, and a vertical-bar thumb that bounces as it lands on each step.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: returns-calendar
json.title: Returns Calendar
json.description: Composable monthly returns calendar with Grid and Tooltip parts, controlled month or year selections, and compounded totals. Supply your own years and monthly percentages.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: select
json.title: Select Select
json.description: Composable primitives (Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem); the panel pinches off the trigger and separates, with staggered items. Position-aware (opens upward when needed).
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: shader-background
json.title: Shader Background
json.description: Canvas shader backgrounds (mesh gradient, grain, warp, waves, voronoi, dot orbit and more) with a single typed variant prop. Reduced-motion freezes animated variants.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: shared-layout-bg
json.title: Shared Layout Background
json.description: A pill that glides between hovered items via motion's shared layout, with blur enter/exit.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.name: signup-form
json.title: Sign Up Form
json.description: Composed sign-up form that flags a field only once it is left, then clears the moment it is fixed, with a length-weighted strength meter, password reveal and an animated submit lifecycle.
json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>

json.author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>
